subject: How to open a local pdf file after clicking on an action button?

messages.author: 7794973310e701f9
messages.subject: How to open a local pdf file after clicking on an action button?
parts:
I am wondering whether it's possible to link a local pdf file to an action button in Shiny. For example, I have a "Manual" action button. A pdf file will be opened once the user clicks the "Manual" button.


Thank you very much for any clues.
